target.title: fix(cli): exit after hooks inspection output
target.body:
## Summary

- refresh the hooks CLI one-shot exit fix onto current `main`
- keep `hooks list`, `hooks info`, `hooks check`, `hooks enable`, `hooks disable`, and bare `hooks` as one-shot CLI commands
- reuse the shared top-level one-shot exit helper from the merged models CLI fix
- request the exit from the hooks command action, but flush/exit only after `runCli` finalizers complete
- keep relay plus deprecated install/update paths on the normal hooks action wrapper

## What Problem This Solves

Plugin diagnostics can load hook/plugin code. If a plugin/register path leaves a timer/socket/other handle open after the hooks command has already printed its output, the CLI can hang in non-interactive use.

The previous refresh fixed the hang by scheduling `runtime.exit(0)` directly from the hooks command action. Codex correctly flagged that this could race `runCli`'s top-level `finally` cleanup (`disposeCliAgentHarnesses()`, `closeCliMemoryManagers()`, stdin pause). This refresh keeps the one-shot behavior but moves the actual flush/exit responsibility to the shared top-level one-shot exit helper.

## Scope / risk

- PR diff is limited to `src/cli/hooks-cli.ts` and `src/cli/hooks-cli.test.ts`.
- No changelog/release-owned files in the refreshed diff.
- Relay plus deprecated install/update flows still use the normal hooks action wrapper, not the one-shot exit wrapper.
- The hooks command no longer drains streams or calls `runtime.exit()` directly.
- The shared top-level `runCli` flush remains the owner of stdout/stderr drain and final process exit after CLI finalizers complete.

## Current head

- Head: `479d36fb05`
- PR diff vs current `main`: 2 files, 64 insertions / 9 deletions.
- GitHub mergeability after push: `MERGEABLE / UNSTABLE`; checks are recomputing on the refreshed head.

## Evidence

Local verification after addressing the Codex review comment:

- `corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/cli/hooks-cli.ts src/cli/hooks-cli.test.ts`
- `corepack pnpm exec oxlint src/cli/hooks-cli.ts src/cli/hooks-cli.test.ts src/cli/one-shot-exit.ts src/cli/run-main.ts src/cli/run-main.exit.test.ts`
- `corepack pnpm test src/cli/hooks-cli.test.ts src/cli/one-shot-exit.test.ts src/cli/run-main.exit.test.ts` — 153 tests passed
- `corepack pnpm test test/scripts/package-acceptance-workflow.test.ts` — 42 tests passed
- `corepack pnpm check:no-conflict-markers`
- `corepack pnpm check:madge-import-cycles` — 0 cycles
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD -- src/cli/hooks-cli.ts src/cli/hooks-cli.test.ts`

Behavior evidence:

- The hooks regression now proves the hooks command action only requests a one-shot exit and does not call `defaultRuntime.exit()` before `runCli` finalizers flush.
- The shared one-shot helper tests cover the stdout/stderr callback barrier and Vitest/custom-runtime guardrails.
- The existing `run-main.exit.test.ts` coverage proves one-shot exit flushing happens after asynchronous harness and memory cleanup.
